title: Ley Orgánica de Solidaridad y de Corresponsabilidad Ciudadana para la Reconstrucción y Reactivación de las Zonas Afectadas por el Terremoto de 16 de abril de 2016, art. 4 (contribución solidaria sobre el patrimonio)
by: President Rafael Correa (bill); Asamblea Nacional (approved with 94 votes)
summary: Article 4 makes individuals with net wealth of USD 1 million or more on 1 January 2016 pay a contribution of 0.90% once, on assets in and outside Ecuador for residents and in Ecuador for non-residents, with an exemption for those directly damaged by the earthquake.
status: Published in Registro Oficial Suplemento 759 of 20 May 2016; a one-off payment, so there is nothing left to collect

title: Ley Orgánica para el Desarrollo Económico y Sostenibilidad Fiscal tras la Pandemia COVID-19: contribución temporal sobre el patrimonio de personas naturales y sociedades
by: President Guillermo Lasso (bill of 28 October 2021); Asamblea Nacional (committee report of 13 November 2021)
summary: Creates two temporary contributions on net wealth: for individuals with USD 1 million or more on 1 January 2021 (1% to 1.5% of the wealth declared, paid by 31 March 2022) and for companies with USD 5 million or more (0.8% a year for two years). The Assembly did not vote within 30 days and the president promulgated the law.
status: In force from the Registro Oficial 587 of 29 November 2021; the personal contribution was a single payment due in March 2022 (Primicias, 17 March 2022), so it has run its course

title: Impuesto permanente a las Grandes Fortunas en Ecuador generaría más de USD 4 mil millones
by: Jonathan Báez Valencia (Instituto de Investigaciones Económicas, Universidad Central del Ecuador)
summary: Estimates that a permanent progressive tax on the assets of the 270 economic groups (1,237 shareholders) would raise about USD 4.1 billion on 2019 data, with rates of 2.25% to 3.50%, and argues that it must be permanent.
